Card Q&A.a: It refers to a card that has 1 of the same colors as the specified card.
Card Q&A.q: What colors of cards does "the same color" as the specified card refer to?
If I choose a single-color red Tamer for this card's [Main] effect, can I play a multicolor Digimon card that includes red?
If I choose a red and blue 2-color Tamer for this card's [Main] effect, can I play a single-color red or blue Digimon card?

Effect: While you have a Tamer, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Main] Choose 1 Tamer. You may play 1 play cost 3 or lower Digimon card of the same color as the chosen Tamer from your hand or trash without paying the cost.
Security Effect: [Security] You may play 1 Tamer card from your hand without paying the cost. Then, add this card to the hand.
